headline: UCL begins publishing daily confirmed case counts
detail: First row of the published series. 336 readings follow, to 2022-05-11.
notes: The case page was announced in issue 110 of 9 September 2020 and described in issue 119 of 12 October 2020, but the first published figure is dated 2020-10-09. Figures were published each weekday morning correct to 5pm the previous day, with weekend figures folded into Tuesday, so a Tuesday reading covers Saturday to Monday.

headline: Monthly cases falls to 11 for students, on campus
detail: 43 in November 2020, 11 in December 2020, a change of -74%.
notes: Threshold: at least 50% and at least 25 cases, both from timeline.toml. Reported confirmed cases only, an undercount of unknown size. Testing intensity changed during the series: asymptomatic testing was ruled out in September 2020, opened to students in November 2020 and to staff in January 2021, and from 8 February 2021 a positive lateral flow test entered the count without PCR confirmation. "On campus" records a visit of 15 minutes or more in the two days before symptoms or a test, not where infection occurred.

headline: Collection outage of 50 hours
detail: The hourly scraper stopped for 50 hours, so any page updates in that window were not captured.
notes: The collection had a 50-hour outage from 2021-08-21 08:34 to 2021-08-23 10:34 caused by the git corruption incident. Any data-track claim spanning this window carries this caveat. The published figures are cumulative, so totals recover; daily readings within the window do not.

headline: On-campus student cases: 9 in January 2021, 696 in January 2022
detail: The same calendar month under opposite campus policies. In January 2021 all teaching was online and students were told not to return; in January 2022 campus was open for face-to-face teaching under the higher education exemption from Plan B.
notes: The blog post's central claim, computed rather than asserted. It shows that the on-campus line moved with policy, not that policy caused the difference: national prevalence also differed between the two months, and reported confirmed cases only, an undercount of unknown size. testing intensity changed during the series: asymptomatic testing was ruled out in september 2020, opened to students in november 2020 and to staff in january 2021, and from 8 february 2021 a positive lateral flow test entered the count without pcr confirmation. "On campus" records a visit of 15 minutes or more in the two days before symptoms or a test, not where infection occurred.

headline: The published case series ends
detail: Last row of the series. The scraper continued to 2022-07-29 against a page that had stopped changing.
notes: The record ends because the counting stopped, not because the pandemic did: issue 165 of 4 May 2022 withdrew the advice to test twice weekly as free national testing ended.
